source_author_review_limits: Distinct AI reviewers; source-text inspection; no human approval, new Lean execution, admission or model measurement.
archive_policy: Only added contribution files, supporting evidence, manifest, patch and delivery receipts; no clone, credentials, caches, environments or weights.
hash_policy: Repository contribution hashes are in package manifest. Delivery SHA256SUMS additionally binds that manifest and all delivery files except SHA256SUMS itself.
